title: Report idle when the drain wait loses the race to its own timeout (IFX-V4-005)
goal: Bring the reviewed IFX-V4-005 fix to the protected history: RuntimeDrainCoordinator.WaitForIdleAsync reports idle when the runtime became idle before the timeout was observed, and the drain test waits long enough under load.
acceptanceCriteria: WaitForIdleAsync returns true when idle completed before the timeout cancellation was observed, and still returns false on a real timeout.
Caller cancellation still propagates as OperationCanceledException.
The positive drain test bound is 30 s and a parallel-load idle test is added.
The two files are byte-identical to the reviewed development-branch commit 739fc279.
